title: "Wrap-up"

## Recap

In one session, participants went from an empty project to coded data, a journal, a retrieval report and a thematic map.

1.  **Set up:** project, files, cases, attributes.
2.  **Code:** codes, categories, memos, important quotes.
3.  **Analyze:** retrieve, filter by attributes, compare, visualise.
4.  **Reflect:** journals, and critical thinking about AI.

## Before you leave

-   [ ] Close QualCoder before copying or zipping your project.

-   [ ] Zip the whole .qda folder and save a copy somewhere safe.

-   [ ] Note your coder name; use the same one next time.
